content.short: No-code token launcher that deploys an ERC-20 with instant liquidity, fee rewards and presales.
content.description: Clanker became the default way to launch tokens on Base, and now also supports Arbitrum, BNB Chain and more. A creator names a token and Clanker deploys it with a liquidity pool in one step, then shares trading fees back with the creator. Tokens launched through it have traded more than $29 billion, including BNKR from Bankr, and it offers presales and an agent skill so AI agents can launch tokens too.
content.meta: Launch an ERC-20 with liquidity and creator fee rewards in one step on Clanker, the launcher behind $29B+ in token volume.
